title: The scale is free, the clerk is not
body: The scale is clear, but the clerk is still checking the weights against the last lot. The Banda cargo can be set down beside the beam; it cannot be entered yet.
notes: fact: Pires names secretaries and receivers for goods weighed in and out of Melaka (docs/research/port-labour.md §2; Pires II, p. 274).
inference: Weighing and recording are distinct work even where one team handles both (docs/research/port-labour.md §§2, 4).
gameplay: This shortage and its duration are invented, not a historical crew count or wage.
